rules.eose_program: EOSE uncovered excluded; Open EOSE CC counts in Covered
rules.called_away_date: Called-away date for Yes rows = Expiration
rules.metrics_split: Since 2026-10-26: Income = CC net + daytrades + dividends (excl. assignment); Assignment P&L separate, booked in called-away week; Overall = Income + Assignment
rules.return_on_program_cost_basis: Income ÷ Program capital (cost basis of program positions). Weekly = week Income ÷ Program capital; all-time = all Income ÷ Program capital; avg weekly = completed-week average
rules.return_on_program_start_value: Week Income ÷ start-of-week value = Monday-open value plus same-week buys at cost: market value of PROGRAM stock held at the Monday open (same membership as Program capital; shares = Fidelity positions CSV adjusted by activity CSVs to the Monday open; price = Robinhood regular-session open that Monday, source robinhood_historical) PLUS program-eligible stock bought that week, Monday after the open through Friday (≥100 sh after the buy, ex-SLNH/TSLA/EOSE), at its cost from the Fidelity activity CSV; shares sold or called away mid-week are not subtracted. Margin, cash, pending activity, non-program stock and options excluded. Not reconstructable = null (n/a). All-time = sum of weekly returns over completed weeks with a value; avg weekly = their mean
rules.removed_2026_10_26: ROC vs Covered, ROC vs Active, capital-deployed return and their averages are no longer published
